sets.relationshipLabel: a specialist and the tool their work depends on
sets.explanation: A sniper needs a rifle and a safecracker needs a lockpick — each specialist is defined by the tool that makes their skill possible.

sets.relationshipLabel: a broad category and one specific kind within it
sets.explanation: A wig is a kind of disguise and a visa is a kind of document — each pair moves from the general category to one concrete example.

sets.relationshipLabel: two mirrored moments that face each other across a mission
sets.explanation: Briefing mirrors debriefing and infiltration mirrors exfiltration — each pair marks the entry and exit points of the same operation.

sets.relationshipLabel: a role and the object that marks someone as holding it
sets.explanation: An alias marks a spy and a cyanide pill marks an operative — each object is the quiet signature of the role someone occupies.
